case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready to take this job onto the shop floor. Option A is built to keep them busy on the pump shaft for our new HX series, and it is the package we can approve.

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On the competing offer:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

Several bidders are in the running, and the award goes to the best package. Option A sets out a price and lead time that we can approve as they stand, and we would rather work this out with a family company we already know than with a stranger.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Hallo, thanks for the clear numbers. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. The 14 days payment helps us out, so I can give you a better price for that and the 35 days lead time. I can do €30.50 per piece, which is a big step from our side to keep the machines running for you. Our offer is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Dralveck,

You wrote that the step to keep your machines running for us was a big one from your side, and we appreciate it. Option A is the package we can approve, and it is built to give your shop steady work on the pump shaft for our new HX series, with payment and lead time as you proposed them.

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.92; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

Several bidders are still in the running, and the award goes to the best package overall, which we cannot promise in advance. We would like it to be a fair solution for both family companies.

You mentioned that you need to clarify matters internally.

Please take Option A up internally and let us know where you stand. Then we can find the way to a good partnership.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Hallo, we checked things internally like you asked. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. I can make a big step down to €28.00 per piece to keep the machines running for you. 

Our offer is a price of €28.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. With the 14 days payment this is a fair deal for both of us, so let's get it done. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work together with you and to prove ourselves as a reliable, long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to offer you a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 52 days. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We really look forward to hearing from you soon and hope we can start a great cooperation!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Ms Procházková,

You wrote that you want to prove yourselves as a reliable, long-term partner, and Option A below is built for exactly that: it gives you the planning security of the longest payment-free horizon and a clear basis for scheduling your capacity with us.

Several bidders are competing for the HX series pump shaft, and the award goes to the best overall package. We cannot promise it in advance. Option A is the package we can approve, because the claims below bear directly on price and delivery, and Option A is where our terms reflect them.

On quality:
Your quality was 980 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

On the cost side:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On alloy:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 25.99; payment 90 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 25.84; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 25.76; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Please take Option A to your management as it stands: it is a clear, complete package for this shaft, and it lets your team plan its work with us.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. I checked the PPI and alloy numbers you sent, they did go down a bit so I can drop the price to €31.00. 

Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our Angebot is a price of €34.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Alternatively, at our standard terms, with a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.

Quality Manager: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.
